sloka: राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य धर्मचारी महारथः ।पूजनीयः च मान्यः च भवान् प्राप्तः प्रिय अतिथिः ॥३-१२-३०॥
transliteration: rājā sarvasya lokasya dharmacārī mahārathaḥ ।pūjanīyaḥ ca mānyaḥ ca bhavān prāptaḥ priya atithiḥ ॥3-12-30॥

translations.english: You are king of all the worlds, a follower of dharma, a great warrior worthy of worship and an esteemed self. O Rama you are such a dear guest come to me.
